module_summary: Round-robin arbiter selecting one of N requesters with rotating priority token, maintaining grant and busy state registers.

anchors.name: token_r
anchors.why: Round-robin priority token pointer; rotates after each grant to ensure fairness

anchors.name: sel_r
anchors.why: Grant selection register holding one-hot encoded grant; driven by rr_pick arbitration

anchors.name: busy_r
anchors.why: Busy flag tracking active grant; cleared by accept, set by any request while idle

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Request input vector from N requesters; drives rr_pick and any_ask logic

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Accept/ready handshake signal; triggers busy release and token rotation

anchors.name: cand
anchors.why: Candidate grant from rr_pick child instance; selected based on round-robin priority

anchors.name: any_ask
anchors.why: Request pending flag (OR of all requests); gates busy_r activation from idle

anchors.name: release_now
anchors.why: Release condition (busy AND accept); triggers token rotation and sel_r clear

groups.name: Arbitration_State
groups.description: Token, selection, and busy state registers managing round-robin grant arbitration

groups.name: Request_Interface
groups.description: Request input vector from N clients

groups.name: Handshake_Control
groups.description: Accept/ready handshake controlling grant and token state updates

groups.name: Priority_Selection
groups.description: Round-robin candidate selection from rr_pick child; steers sel_r update

groups.name: Arbitration_Control
groups.description: Request pending and release condition flags driving state transitions

groups.name: Output_Interface
groups.description: Grant and valid output ports driven by sel_r and busy_r
